meta.name: atlas-cloud-media
meta.description: Discover Atlas Cloud image and video models, inspect their live schemas, and submit one confirmed media generation request with bounded GET polling. Use when integrating Atlas Cloud media APIs or generating images and videos without hard-coding stale model parameters.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调用云媒体服务生成图片和视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在为应用接入图像和视频生成能力。
copy.tagline_en: Generate images and videos via cloud media service.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are integrating image and video generation into your app.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用脚本查询 Atlas Cloud 当前的图片/视频模型,查看某模型的实时请求格式,并提交一次经确认的媒体生成请求,期间用 GET 轮询结果。
howto.when: 当你要找 Atlas Cloud 可用的图片或视频模型、需要当前模型 ID/字段/价格等实时信息,或想提交一次已确认的媒体生成请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 Atlas Cloud 现在有哪些图片模型可用。
say.note: 会列出当前可用的图片模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use a Python CLI to discover current Atlas Cloud image/video models, inspect a model's live request schema, and submit one explicitly confirmed media generation request while polling the result endpoint with GET.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to find an available Atlas Cloud image/video model, need current model ID, fields, endpoint, or price, or want to submit one confirmed media generation request.

say_en.text: List the Atlas Cloud image models currently available.
say_en.note: Returns the current list of available image models.

say_en.text: Show the latest request schema and price for black-forest-labs/flux-schnell.
say_en.note: Returns live schema and catalog price.

say_en.text: Generate a product photo with flux-schnell using request.json, confirm cost, then run.
say_en.note: Confirms cost, sends one generation request, and polls.
